panels.title: Idle time piling up, per run
panels.description: Every gap over two minutes, added up as the run went. A staircase that climbs as fast as the run is a run that is mostly waiting: 377 of 636 minutes, once.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT at AS time, name AS metric, value FROM limits WHERE name = 'limits.memory_mb' AND at*1000 <= $__to AND (at*1000 >= $__from OR at = (SELECT max(at) FROM limits WHERE name = 'limits.memory_mb' AND at*1000 < $__from)) ORDER BY at
targets.queryText: SELECT at AS time, name AS metric, value FROM limits WHERE name = 'limits.memory_mb' AND at*1000 <= $__to AND (at*1000 >= $__from OR at = (SELECT max(at) FROM limits WHERE name = 'limits.memory_mb' AND at*1000 < $__from)) ORDER BY at

panels.title: Time in a session, minute by minute
panels.description: How long the open session has been open, by agent.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(e.at/60 AS INTEGER)*60 AS time, coalesce(nullif(e.agent,''),'?') AS metric, max(e.at - (SELECT a.at FROM events a WHERE a.kind = 'session_start' AND a.run = e.run AND a.agent = e.agent AND a.at <= e.at ORDER BY a.at DESC LIMIT 1)) AS value FROM events e WHERE e.at*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND e.run IS NOT NULL AND ifnull(e.agent,'') <> '' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(e.at/60 AS INTEGER)*60 AS time, coalesce(nullif(e.agent,''),'?') AS metric, max(e.at - (SELECT a.at FROM events a WHERE a.kind = 'session_start' AND a.run = e.run AND a.agent = e.agent AND a.at <= e.at ORDER BY a.at DESC LIMIT 1)) AS value FROM events e WHERE e.at*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND e.run IS NOT NULL AND ifnull(e.agent,'') <> '' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT at AS time, name AS metric, value FROM limits WHERE name = 'timeouts.session' AND at*1000 <= $__to AND (at*1000 >= $__from OR at = (SELECT max(at) FROM limits WHERE name = 'timeouts.session' AND at*1000 < $__from)) ORDER BY at
targets.queryText: SELECT at AS time, name AS metric, value FROM limits WHERE name = 'timeouts.session' AND at*1000 <= $__to AND (at*1000 >= $__from OR at = (SELECT max(at) FROM limits WHERE name = 'timeouts.session' AND at*1000 < $__from)) ORDER BY at

panels.title: Tokens out, per run
panels.description: Generated tokens as they accrued. This is the number that moves the bill; cache read below is charged at a fraction of it.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT * FROM (SELECT at AS time, (SELECT r.name FROM runs r WHERE r.run = events.run) AS metric, sum(json_extract(payload,'$.tokens_out')) OVER (PARTITION BY (SELECT r.name FROM runs r WHERE r.run = events.run) ORDER BY at) AS value FROM events WHERE run NOT IN (SELECT run FROM runs WHERE started*1000 > $__to OR (finished IS NOT NULL AND finished*1000 < $__from)) AND kind = 'spend' ORDER BY at) WHERE time*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to
targets.queryText: SELECT * FROM (SELECT at AS time, (SELECT r.name FROM runs r WHERE r.run = events.run) AS metric, sum(json_extract(payload,'$.tokens_out')) OVER (PARTITION BY (SELECT r.name FROM runs r WHERE r.run = events.run) ORDER BY at) AS value FROM events WHERE run NOT IN (SELECT run FROM runs WHERE started*1000 > $__to OR (finished IS NOT NULL AND finished*1000 < $__from)) AND kind = 'spend' ORDER BY at) WHERE time*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to

panels.title: Tokens out, by phase
panels.description: Which phase is generating the volume.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT * FROM (SELECT at AS time, coalesce(nullif(phase,''),'no phase') AS metric, sum(json_extract(payload,'$.tokens_out')) OVER (PARTITION BY coalesce(nullif(phase,''),'no phase') ORDER BY at) AS value FROM events WHERE run NOT IN (SELECT run FROM runs WHERE started*1000 > $__to OR (finished IS NOT NULL AND finished*1000 < $__from)) AND kind = 'spend' ORDER BY at) WHERE time*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to
targets.queryText: SELECT * FROM (SELECT at AS time, coalesce(nullif(phase,''),'no phase') AS metric, sum(json_extract(payload,'$.tokens_out')) OVER (PARTITION BY coalesce(nullif(phase,''),'no phase') ORDER BY at) AS value FROM events WHERE run NOT IN (SELECT run FROM runs WHERE started*1000 > $__to OR (finished IS NOT NULL AND finished*1000 < $__from)) AND kind = 'spend' ORDER BY at) WHERE time*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to

panels.title: Tokens out, by agent
panels.description: And which agent inside it.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT * FROM (SELECT at AS time, coalesce(nullif(agent,''),'?') AS metric, sum(json_extract(payload,'$.tokens_out')) OVER (PARTITION BY coalesce(nullif(agent,''),'?') ORDER BY at) AS value FROM events WHERE run NOT IN (SELECT run FROM runs WHERE started*1000 > $__to OR (finished IS NOT NULL AND finished*1000 < $__from)) AND kind = 'spend' ORDER BY at) WHERE time*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to
targets.queryText: SELECT * FROM (SELECT at AS time, coalesce(nullif(agent,''),'?') AS metric, sum(json_extract(payload,'$.tokens_out')) OVER (PARTITION BY coalesce(nullif(agent,''),'?') ORDER BY at) AS value FROM events WHERE run NOT IN (SELECT run FROM runs WHERE started*1000 > $__to OR (finished IS NOT NULL AND finished*1000 < $__from)) AND kind = 'spend' ORDER BY at) WHERE time*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to

panels.title: Cache read, per run
panels.description: Context read back rather than re-sent. Large is good here: it is the same prompt not being paid for twice.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT * FROM (SELECT at AS time, (SELECT r.name FROM runs r WHERE r.run = events.run) AS metric, sum(json_extract(payload,'$.cache_read')) OVER (PARTITION BY (SELECT r.name FROM runs r WHERE r.run = events.run) ORDER BY at) AS value FROM events WHERE run NOT IN (SELECT run FROM runs WHERE started*1000 > $__to OR (finished IS NOT NULL AND finished*1000 < $__from)) AND kind = 'spend' ORDER BY at) WHERE time*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to
targets.queryText: SELECT * FROM (SELECT at AS time, (SELECT r.name FROM runs r WHERE r.run = events.run) AS metric, sum(json_extract(payload,'$.cache_read')) OVER (PARTITION BY (SELECT r.name FROM runs r WHERE r.run = events.run) ORDER BY at) AS value FROM events WHERE run NOT IN (SELECT run FROM runs WHERE started*1000 > $__to OR (finished IS NOT NULL AND finished*1000 < $__from)) AND kind = 'spend' ORDER BY at) WHERE time*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to

panels.title: Cache written, per run
panels.description: Context put into the cache. Written once, read many times — a run where this keeps climbing is a run whose prompt will not settle.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT * FROM (SELECT at AS time, (SELECT r.name FROM runs r WHERE r.run = events.run) AS metric, sum(json_extract(payload,'$.cache_write')) OVER (PARTITION BY (SELECT r.name FROM runs r WHERE r.run = events.run) ORDER BY at) AS value FROM events WHERE run NOT IN (SELECT run FROM runs WHERE started*1000 > $__to OR (finished IS NOT NULL AND finished*1000 < $__from)) AND kind = 'spend' ORDER BY at) WHERE time*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to
targets.queryText: SELECT * FROM (SELECT at AS time, (SELECT r.name FROM runs r WHERE r.run = events.run) AS metric, sum(json_extract(payload,'$.cache_write')) OVER (PARTITION BY (SELECT r.name FROM runs r WHERE r.run = events.run) ORDER BY at) AS value FROM events WHERE run NOT IN (SELECT run FROM runs WHERE started*1000 > $__to OR (finished IS NOT NULL AND finished*1000 < $__from)) AND kind = 'spend' ORDER BY at) WHERE time*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to

panels.title: Tokens and what they cost
panels.description: Every run in the window: what it generated, what it read back, and the bill.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT r.started AS started, r.name AS run, coalesce(r.verdict,'running') AS verdict, CAST(sum(json_extract(e.payload,'$.tokens_out')) AS INTEGER) AS tokens_out, CAST(sum(json_extract(e.payload,'$.cache_read')) AS INTEGER) AS cache_read, CAST(sum(json_extract(e.payload,'$.cache_write')) AS INTEGER) AS cache_write, ROUND(sum(json_extract(e.payload,'$.usd')), 2) AS usd FROM events e JOIN runs r ON r.run = e.run WHERE e.kind = 'spend' AND e.run NOT IN (SELECT run FROM runs WHERE started*1000 > $__to OR (finished IS NOT NULL AND finished*1000 < $__from)) GROUP BY e.run ORDER BY r.started DESC LIMIT 50
targets.queryText: SELECT r.started AS started, r.name AS run, coalesce(r.verdict,'running') AS verdict, CAST(sum(json_extract(e.payload,'$.tokens_out')) AS INTEGER) AS tokens_out, CAST(sum(json_extract(e.payload,'$.cache_read')) AS INTEGER) AS cache_read, CAST(sum(json_extract(e.payload,'$.cache_write')) AS INTEGER) AS cache_write, ROUND(sum(json_extract(e.payload,'$.usd')), 2) AS usd FROM events e JOIN runs r ON r.run = e.run WHERE e.kind = 'spend' AND e.run NOT IN (SELECT run FROM runs WHERE started*1000 > $__to OR (finished IS NOT NULL AND finished*1000 < $__from)) GROUP BY e.run ORDER BY r.started DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Memory by container against limits.memory_mb
panels.description: Read from outside every sample.every seconds. A worker the kernel kills leaves no evidence of its own: the process that would have said so is the one that died.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT at AS time, json_extract(payload,'$.container') AS metric, json_extract(payload,'$.memory_mb') AS value FROM events WHERE at*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND kind = 'sample' ORDER BY at
targets.queryText: SELECT at AS time, json_extract(payload,'$.container') AS metric, json_extract(payload,'$.memory_mb') AS value FROM events WHERE at*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND kind = 'sample' ORDER BY at

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT at AS time, name AS metric, value FROM limits WHERE name = 'limits.memory_mb' AND at*1000 <= $__to AND (at*1000 >= $__from OR at = (SELECT max(at) FROM limits WHERE name = 'limits.memory_mb' AND at*1000 < $__from)) ORDER BY at
targets.queryText: SELECT at AS time, name AS metric, value FROM limits WHERE name = 'limits.memory_mb' AND at*1000 <= $__to AND (at*1000 >= $__from OR at = (SELECT max(at) FROM limits WHERE name = 'limits.memory_mb' AND at*1000 < $__from)) ORDER BY at

panels.title: CPU by container
panels.description: Percent of one core, as the container client reports it.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT at AS time, json_extract(payload,'$.container') AS metric, json_extract(payload,'$.cpu_pct') AS value FROM events WHERE at*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND kind = 'sample' ORDER BY at
targets.queryText: SELECT at AS time, json_extract(payload,'$.container') AS metric, json_extract(payload,'$.cpu_pct') AS value FROM events WHERE at*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND kind = 'sample' ORDER BY at

panels.title: Processes by container
panels.description: A count that climbs and never falls is something not being reaped — the browser runs this pipeline leaves behind, most often.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT at AS time, json_extract(payload,'$.container') AS metric, json_extract(payload,'$.pids') AS value FROM events WHERE at*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND kind = 'sample' ORDER BY at
targets.queryText: SELECT at AS time, json_extract(payload,'$.container') AS metric, json_extract(payload,'$.pids') AS value FROM events WHERE at*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND kind = 'sample' ORDER BY at

panels.title: Phases and branches
panels.description: What each branch was doing, minute by minute.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT time, run, phase FROM ( SELECT CAST(e.at/60 AS INTEGER)*60 AS time, max('#' || n.seq) AS run, max(coalesce(nullif(e.phase,''), e.agent, '?')) AS phase FROM events e LEFT JOIN (SELECT run, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY started) AS seq FROM runs) n ON n.run = e.run WHERE e.at*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND e.kind IN ('turn','log','session_start') GROUP BY 1) ORDER BY time
targets.queryText: SELECT time, run, phase FROM ( SELECT CAST(e.at/60 AS INTEGER)*60 AS time, max('#' || n.seq) AS run, max(coalesce(nullif(e.phase,''), e.agent, '?')) AS phase FROM events e LEFT JOIN (SELECT run, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY started) AS seq FROM runs) n ON n.run = e.run WHERE e.at*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND e.kind IN ('turn','log','session_start') GROUP BY 1) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Findings per gate, each time it ran
panels.description: How much each check refuses, round by round. A gate that never finds anything is a tollbooth; one whose findings do not fall between rounds is asking for something the repair cannot give.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT at*1000 AS time, phase AS metric, findings AS value FROM gates ORDER BY at
targets.queryText: SELECT at*1000 AS time, phase AS metric, findings AS value FROM gates ORDER BY at

panels.title: How long a round takes, by gate
panels.description: The check plus the repair it caused. A loop that costs more than the fault is a loop worth removing.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT at*1000 AS time, phase AS metric, seconds AS value FROM gates WHERE seconds > 0 ORDER BY at
targets.queryText: SELECT at*1000 AS time, phase AS metric, seconds AS value FROM gates WHERE seconds > 0 ORDER BY at

panels.title: Rounds to green, per gate
panels.description: How many times each check had to run before it stopped refusing, and what the rounds cost. One round is a check doing its job; three is a repair that cannot hear what is being asked.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT phase, coalesce(nullif(branch,''),'—') AS branch, max(round) AS rounds, sum(findings) AS findings_total, ROUND(sum(seconds)/60.0,1) AS minutes, max(CASE WHEN verdict='green' THEN 'reached green' ELSE verdict END) AS ended FROM gates GROUP BY phase, branch ORDER BY minutes DESC LIMIT 60
targets.queryText: SELECT phase, coalesce(nullif(branch,''),'—') AS branch, max(round) AS rounds, sum(findings) AS findings_total, ROUND(sum(seconds)/60.0,1) AS minutes, max(CASE WHEN verdict='green' THEN 'reached green' ELSE verdict END) AS ended FROM gates GROUP BY phase, branch ORDER BY minutes DESC LIMIT 60

panels.title: Busy and idle, per run
panels.description: Elapsed against the part of it where nothing happened for more than two minutes.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT r.started AS started, r.finished AS finished, r.name AS run, coalesce(r.verdict,'running') AS verdict, CAST((coalesce(r.finished, strftime('%s','now')) - r.started)/60 AS INTEGER) AS elapsed_min, CAST(((coalesce(r.finished, strftime('%s','now')) - r.started) - coalesce(g.idle,0))/60 AS INTEGER) AS busy_min, CAST(coalesce(g.idle,0)/60 AS INTEGER) AS idle_min, ROUND(100.0*coalesce(g.idle,0) / max(1.0, coalesce(r.finished, strftime('%s','now')) - r.started), 1) AS idle_pct, ROUND(coalesce(r.usd,0),2) AS usd FROM runs r LEFT JOIN ( SELECT run, sum(gap) AS idle FROM ( SELECT run, CASE WHEN at - lag(at) OVER (PARTITION BY run ORDER BY at) > 120 THEN at - lag(at) OVER (PARTITION BY run ORDER BY at) ELSE 0 END AS gap FROM events WHERE run NOT IN (SELECT run FROM runs WHERE started*1000 > $__to OR (finished IS NOT NULL AND finished*1000 < $__from)) AND run IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY run) g ON g.run = r.run ORDER BY r.started DESC LIMIT 50
targets.queryText: SELECT r.started AS started, r.finished AS finished, r.name AS run, coalesce(r.verdict,'running') AS verdict, CAST((coalesce(r.finished, strftime('%s','now')) - r.started)/60 AS INTEGER) AS elapsed_min, CAST(((coalesce(r.finished, strftime('%s','now')) - r.started) - coalesce(g.idle,0))/60 AS INTEGER) AS busy_min, CAST(coalesce(g.idle,0)/60 AS INTEGER) AS idle_min, ROUND(100.0*coalesce(g.idle,0) / max(1.0, coalesce(r.finished, strftime('%s','now')) - r.started), 1) AS idle_pct, ROUND(coalesce(r.usd,0),2) AS usd FROM runs r LEFT JOIN ( SELECT run, sum(gap) AS idle FROM ( SELECT run, CASE WHEN at - lag(at) OVER (PARTITION BY run ORDER BY at) > 120 THEN at - lag(at) OVER (PARTITION BY run ORDER BY at) ELSE 0 END AS gap FROM events WHERE run NOT IN (SELECT run FROM runs WHERE started*1000 > $__to OR (finished IS NOT NULL AND finished*1000 < $__from)) AND run IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY run) g ON g.run = r.run ORDER BY r.started DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: The longest gaps
panels.description: Every stretch over five minutes where nothing was reported, newest first. What was open when it started is the first place to look.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT * FROM (SELECT at AS at, run, coalesce(nullif(phase,''),'') AS phase, coalesce(nullif(agent,''),'') AS agent, CAST(gap/60 AS INTEGER) AS minutes FROM (SELECT at, run, phase, agent, at - lag(at) OVER (PARTITION BY run ORDER BY at) AS gap FROM events WHERE run NOT IN (SELECT run FROM runs WHERE started*1000 > $__to OR (finished IS NOT NULL AND finished*1000 < $__from)) AND run IS NOT NULL) WHERE gap > 300 ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT 50) WHERE at*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to
targets.queryText: SELECT * FROM (SELECT at AS at, run, coalesce(nullif(phase,''),'') AS phase, coalesce(nullif(agent,''),'') AS agent, CAST(gap/60 AS INTEGER) AS minutes FROM (SELECT at, run, phase, agent, at - lag(at) OVER (PARTITION BY run ORDER BY at) AS gap FROM events WHERE run NOT IN (SELECT run FROM runs WHERE started*1000 > $__to OR (finished IS NOT NULL AND finished*1000 < $__from)) AND run IS NOT NULL) WHERE gap > 300 ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT 50) WHERE at*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to

panels.title: What ammit did
panels.description: Every limit crossed, what it did about it, and what the command said back.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT at AS at, scope, coalesce(subject,'') AS subject, rule, threshold, observed, action, coalesce(outcome,'') AS outcome FROM judgements ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 200
targets.queryText: SELECT at AS at, scope, coalesce(subject,'') AS subject, rule, threshold, observed, action, coalesce(outcome,'') AS outcome FROM judgements ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 200

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT started AS started, finished AS finished, name, coalesce(verdict,'running') AS verdict, CAST((coalesce(finished, strftime('%s','now')) - started)/60 AS INTEGER) AS minutes, ROUND(coalesce(usd,0),2) AS usd, coalesce(turns,0) AS turns, coalesce(summary,'') AS summary FROM runs ORDER BY started DESC LIMIT 50
targets.queryText: SELECT started AS started, finished AS finished, name, coalesce(verdict,'running') AS verdict, CAST((coalesce(finished, strftime('%s','now')) - started)/60 AS INTEGER) AS minutes, ROUND(coalesce(usd,0),2) AS usd, coalesce(turns,0) AS turns, coalesce(summary,'') AS summary FROM runs ORDER BY started DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Limits, as they stand
panels.description: What every chart above is drawn against, and when it last changed.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT name, value, at AS changed FROM limits WHERE id IN (SELECT max(id) FROM limits GROUP BY name) ORDER BY name
targets.queryText: SELECT name, value, at AS changed FROM limits WHERE id IN (SELECT max(id) FROM limits GROUP BY name) ORDER BY name

panels.title: The same call, again
panels.description: One row per distinct call that ran more than once in the window. This is the question the calls table was added for: a branch ran the same search for step phrases eleven times, and nobody knew until somebody counted by hand.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT agent, branch, kind, count(*) AS times, signature FROM calls WHERE at*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to GROUP BY agent, branch, signature HAVING times > 1 ORDER BY times DESC LIMIT 60
targets.queryText: SELECT agent, branch, kind, count(*) AS times, signature FROM calls WHERE at*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to GROUP BY agent, branch, signature HAVING times > 1 ORDER BY times DESC LIMIT 60

panels.title: The same file, however it was reached
panels.description: Grouped by what was touched rather than how it was touched. Read, then cat, then three sed windows is five calls and one file — which is how a single step module came to be opened fifteen times in fourteen different ways.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT agent, branch, target, group_concat(DISTINCT kind) AS kinds, count(*) AS times, count(DISTINCT signature) AS ways FROM calls WHERE at*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND ifnull(target,'') <> '' GROUP BY agent, branch, target HAVING times > 1 ORDER BY times DESC LIMIT 60
targets.queryText: SELECT agent, branch, target, group_concat(DISTINCT kind) AS kinds, count(*) AS times, count(DISTINCT signature) AS ways FROM calls WHERE at*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND ifnull(target,'') <> '' GROUP BY agent, branch, target HAVING times > 1 ORDER BY times DESC LIMIT 60

panels.title: What each phase spent its calls on
panels.description: Every call of the window by kind. Writing and running tests are the work; everything else is what it cost to get there.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT phase, kind, count(*) AS times FROM calls WHERE at*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to GROUP BY phase, kind ORDER BY times DESC LIMIT 80
targets.queryText: SELECT phase, kind, count(*) AS times FROM calls WHERE at*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to GROUP BY phase, kind ORDER BY times DESC LIMIT 80
